description: Recorded SEC EDGAR responses for Coherent Corp. (CIK 0000820318), trimmed to reproduce the restatement-link insert-order bug that live verification found on 2026-09-30 (financial_observation_previous_observation_id_fkey). SEC data is public domain. The companyfacts body is what SEC served on 2026-09-30 (one request, User-Agent below), trimmed to three us-gaap period keys whose facts SEC lists newest filing first: AccruedBonusesCurrent at 2010-06-30 (four equal values, 10-Qs and the 10-K of 2010-11..2011-08), the FY2011 foreign-currency translation OCI (9,107,000 in the FY2011 and FY2012 10-Ks, 9,108,000 in the FY2013 10-K) and the FY2011 unrecognized tax benefits penalties and interest (-100,000 in the FY2011 10-K, 100,000 in the FY2012 10-K); labels and descriptions kept, re-serialized with indentation. The submissions index is HAND-WRITTEN: no filings.recent rows, so no documents are fetched and every fact takes the conservative fallback availability (the filing date's end of day, ET).
